name: Trento DOC

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.
Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.
Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.
An aged Italian wine. Chianti Riserva needs at least 6 months in barrel and 3 more in bottle before release.

notes: Trentino wines are balanced between acidity and alcohol and taste clearly of their grape.
Nosiola makes a dry, savory white with a light bitter edge.
Marzemino is a dry, full red with pronounced aromas.
Vino Santo is a golden to amber sweet wine from Nosiola grapes dried on racks for months.
It cannot be sold until November of the third year after harvest.

blurb.text: A DOC for white and rosé sparkling wine made by bottle fermentation in the province of Trento, from Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero and Meunier. Recognized in 1993, it was the first Italian denomination reserved only for traditional method sparkling wine.
